place.name: Ebensee am Traunsee
place.description: Ebensee am Traunsee (Austrian German: [ˈeːbn̩seː am ˈtraʊnseː]; Central Bavarian: Emsee) is a market town in the Traunviertel region of the Austrian state of Upper Austria, located within the Salzkammergut Mountains at the southern end of the Traunsee. The regional capital Linz lies approximately 90 km (56 mi) to the north, nearest towns are Gmunden and Bad Ischl.
